name: Parameters.frob_ext
summary: Both sides of the left condition are ring homomorphisms in x (Frobenius in characteristic p), and 𝓞_E is generated by ζ(P, s) and c₀; at ζ(P, s) the condition is the one on places, at c₀ it is the one on √−d(P) (`eq_map_c₀_pow_iff`).

steps.claim: Chain two equivalences: the condition for all x is equivalent to the conditions at x = ζ(P, s) and x = c₀ (1.1, 1.2), and these to the right side (1.3).
steps.lean:
e * φ (P.sqrtNegDInE s) = φ (P.sqrtNegDInE s) := .trans ⟨fun e ↦ And.intro (e (zetaInt ..))
  (e (c₀InE ..)), fun _ x ↦ by induction (adjoin_eq_adjoin_union ℤ _ _
  (different_eq_span_and_adjoin_c₀ _).2).le ((relDifferent_spec isPrimitiveRoot_zetaInt).2.2.ge
  (x := x) ⟨⟩) using adjoin_induction <;> simp_all [← iterateFrobenius_def]; lia⟩ (by
  erw [← map_pow,
    eq_map_c₀_pow_iff (h <| · ▸ by grind [Parameters] : p ≠ 2) (φ.comp (c.toRingHom.comp _))]
  congrm _ = φ ?_ ∧ ?_ <;> cases he <;> simp [*, RingOfIntegers.ext_iff,
    (isCoprime_N₀_of_not_dvd h).pow_left, galOfPlace_placeOfInt_zeta, IsCoprime.neg_left,
    star_c₀InE, galOfPlaceInt.eq_1 v, sqrtNegDInE] <;> norm_cast <;> grind)

steps.claim: (⇒) Specialise the identity φ(galOfPlace(P, s)(v) x) = φ(c x)^{p^n} (a hypothesis named e in Lean) to x = ζ(P, s) = zetaInt(P, s) and x = c₀ = c₀InE(P, s).

(⇐) 𝓞_K = ℤ[c₀] (`different_eq_span_and_adjoin_c₀`) and 𝓞_E = 𝓞_K[ζ(P, s)] (`relDifferent_spec`), so every x lies in the ring generated by ζ(P, s) and c₀; x ↦ φ(galOfPlace(P, s)(v) x) and x ↦ φ(c x)^{p^n} are ring homomorphisms (the p^n-th power is the n-th iterate of Frobenius in characteristic p), so agreement at ζ(P, s) and c₀ gives agreement everywhere (induction over the generated subring).
steps.lean:
fun _ x ↦ by induction (adjoin_eq_adjoin_union ℤ _ _
  (different_eq_span_and_adjoin_c₀ _).2).le ((relDifferent_spec isPrimitiveRoot_zetaInt).2.2.ge
  (x := x) ⟨⟩) using adjoin_induction <;> simp_all [← iterateFrobenius_def]; lia⟩

steps.claim: The two conditions at ζ(P, s) and c₀ are equivalent to the two conditions of the right side.
steps.lean:
(by
  erw [← map_pow,
    eq_map_c₀_pow_iff (h <| · ▸ by grind [Parameters] : p ≠ 2) (φ.comp (c.toRingHom.comp _))]
  congrm _ = φ ?_ ∧ ?_ <;> cases he <;> simp [*, RingOfIntegers.ext_iff,
    (isCoprime_N₀_of_not_dvd h).pow_left, galOfPlace_placeOfInt_zeta, IsCoprime.neg_left,
    star_c₀InE, galOfPlaceInt.eq_1 v, sqrtNegDInE] <;> norm_cast <;> grind)

steps.claim: Write φ(c x)^{p^n} = (φ∘c)(x)^{p^n}; the condition at c₀ becomes one on √−d(P) by `eq_map_c₀_pow_iff` for the ring homomorphism φ∘c∘(𝓞_K → 𝓞_E) into a ring of characteristic p ≠ 2 (p ≠ 2 because 2 ∣ N₁(P, s) and p ∤ N₁(P, s)): y = ψ(c₀)^{p^n} ⟺ 2y − 1 = χ_K(p)^n·ψ(√−d(P)).
steps.lean:
erw [← map_pow,
    eq_map_c₀_pow_iff (h <| · ▸ by grind [Parameters] : p ≠ 2) (φ.comp (c.toRingHom.comp _))]

steps.claim: Compare both sides in the two cases of he: c(ζ(P, s))^{p^n} = ζ(P, s)^{e·p^n} = galOfPlace(P, s)(u)(ζ(P, s)) with u = placeOfInt(P, s, e·p^n) (`galOfPlace_placeOfInt_zeta`, e·p^n prime to N₀(P) by `isCoprime_N₀_of_not_dvd`), and galOfPlace(P, s)(v) fixes c₀ and √−d(P), while c(c₀) = c₀ or 1 − c₀ (`star_c₀InE`).
steps.lean:
congrm _ = φ ?_ ∧ ?_ <;> cases he <;> simp [*, RingOfIntegers.ext_iff,
    (isCoprime_N₀_of_not_dvd h).pow_left, galOfPlace_placeOfInt_zeta, IsCoprime.neg_left,
    star_c₀InE, galOfPlaceInt.eq_1 v, sqrtNegDInE] <;> norm_cast <;> grind)
